hack.root_cause: Permissionless share price oracle update (updateTotalAum) + flash loan Curve pool manipulation → share price inflation → LP drain
hack.description: Makina Finance is a modular DeFi execution engine with a "Machine" architecture. Dialectic, Makina's first Operator, deployed DUSD tokens into a DUSD/USDC Curve StableSwap pool. The share price oracle () relied on an function that was permissionless and pulled spot prices from Curve's — a function that reflects current pool balances with no time delay, no TWAP, and no access control.
